title: CAPA | Camera AI Productivity Assistant
tagline: A webcam-based focus companion with real-time computer vision and optional local AI.
overview: CAPA (Control-System Camera AI-Powered Productivity Assistant) is a Python desktop application that uses a webcam to estimate desk presence, movement, and visual attention during work sessions. It pairs live feedback with session transcripts and detailed reports, and can optionally request coaching summaries from a local OpenAI-compatible language model.

features.title: Live focus sessions
features.description: Capture webcam frames and combine motion with detected presence to classify focused, distracted, and absent states.

features.title: Face, eye, and posture signals
features.description: Use OpenCV face and eye cascades, body detection, and head-position signals to inform session feedback.

features.title: Motion-based inactivity alerts
features.description: Track motion over time and surface prompts when activity remains low.

features.title: Optional local AI coaching
features.description: Request productivity prompts and session summaries from a locally hosted, OpenAI-compatible language model.

features.title: Session transcripts and reports
features.description: Show live session feedback and save a detailed text report with focus, motion, expression, and recommendation summaries.

roadmap.title: Add automated regression tests
roadmap.description: Cover motion thresholds, presence and attention classification, and report generation so changes can be checked without camera hardware.

roadmap.title: Validate focus signals against labeled sessions
roadmap.description: Measure classification behavior across varied lighting, camera positions, and user-confirmed focus labels; document known limitations.

roadmap.title: Add camera setup and calibration guidance
roadmap.description: Help users choose a camera position and tune detection thresholds for their lighting and workspace.

roadmap.title: Run project checks automatically
roadmap.description: Add a test-focused CI job that runs the regression suite and lightweight source checks on proposed changes.
